rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: FRYstar
Exhibition name: Liverpool Remembers
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 1990).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 1990 as 'Liverpool Remembers'.
rows.Bloom: Vermilion, silver(y) reverse. Mild to strong fragrance. 40 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, upright. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 2' to 31" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.

rows.Notes:
Fryer's Roses says Beauty Star ('Liverpool Remembers') has large, full blooms that are a glowing vermilion, bright and unfading... 'Beauty Star' is the European name for 'Liverpool Remembers.' This rose won a Certificate of Merit from the Belfast Trials...

Participated in the 1999 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
